marta (Finance Ops): Quick announcement: launching a preferred-SaaS pilot and a shared vendor catalog to reduce duplicate subscriptions and unlock volume discounts. Please read and flag any active renewals.
marta (Finance Ops): TL;DR: • Add ongoing SaaS tools to the new "SaaS Catalog" form. • If a tool is already in the catalog, request assignment instead of creating a new subscription. • Preferred vendors may get centralized billing and a discount code; procurement will route those centrally.
jon (IT Procurement): A few operational notes: 1) For existing active subscriptions, fill the catalog form with current PO/SOW and last invoice. 2) New vendors still follow onboarding rules: > $10k = Vendor Risk check.
rana (Product): We have 3 seat-based analytics trials across teams. If we consolidate under a single vendor, how do we split cost centers?
marta (Finance Ops): Good Q @rana. Were enabling "split-charge" tags in the catalog. When you request assignment, include percentage or headcount mapping. Finance will generate the recharge entries monthly.
eli (Legal): For preferred vendor agreements, Legal will review the master discount addendum. If teams sign any new SOWs, route to Legal-first to avoid conflicting terms.
jon (IT Procurement): Pilot timeline: intake opens today; catalog review batch every Tue/Thu. If you need a priority review for renewals within 14 days, mark the form "priority-renewal" and include the renewal date.
marta (Finance Ops): Operational exception: If renewal is < $2,500 and can't be centralized in time, teams may use p-card but MUST add the catalog link in Concur and tag `centralize-later`. We'll reconcile in the monthly sweep.
ops-bot: Automation: SaaS Catalog form -> https://confluence.redwood/procurement/saas-catalog (form at bottom)
rana (Product): We're due for an embedding seats renewal (~$6,400) next week. I'll submit the catalog form now and mark priority-renewal.
jon (IT Procurement): Thanks @rana. If the vendor becomes preferred we may move billing to a central card and apply a negotiated discount; you'll get a notice and a revised invoice mapping.
marta (Finance Ops): One more: consolidated vendors will have a single canonical vendor ID in our AR system. When in doubt, search the catalog before onboarding a duplicate vendor.
eli (Legal): Also: any vendor agreement with data processing implications must include the DP addendum template (link in playbook).
marta (Finance Ops): I'll drop a short checklist and the form link in #general, and run a 15-min drop-in today at 11:30 for questions. Ping me if you need help migrating an urgent renewal. :wave:
